subject: maths
question: Let C be a circle with centre O and PQ be a minor arc on C. Let R and S be two points on the major arc of PQ on C. If PQ subtends an angle 80º at O, find ∠PRQ and ∠PSQ, respectively.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is always double the angle it subtends at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

∠PRQ = ∠POQ ÷ 2 = 80º ÷ 2 = 40º

Angles in the same segment of a circle are equal.

∠PSQ = ∠PRQ = 40º

**∴ The correct answer is 40º and 40º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Angle subtended by minor arc PQ at the centre, ∠POQ = 80º

Points R and S lie on the major arc of PQ.
